main_text.p:
6. At gemellos dentium
Ordines eburneos,
Ordines iunctissimos
Compararim candido
Cum bidentum vellere,
Quæ nitentes vitreo
E lauacro prodeunt,
Cum gemellis singulæ
Hinc & inde fœtibus:
Nulla vt isto de grege
Possit orba confpici.

7. Quale punici rubent
Mali hiantis granula:
Tale quiddam crispulæ
Inter emicat comæ
Tortiles cincinnulos.

8. Sexies regis decem
Coniuges recenseo:
Octies regi decem
Concubinæ sunt mihi:
Sunt puellæ plurimæ.

9. Vna sed columbula,
Labis expers vnica.
Nouit hanc vnam parens
Vnicámque, cæteris
Abdicatis, approbat.
Hanc, puellæ cæteræ,
Regiæque coniuges
Regiæque pellices,
Ter beatam prædicant.
main_text.head: SPONSA.
SPONSVS.

page.notes: Verse column; the page continues beyond this part. Marginal note fragments at the right edge of the column are too faint to read and are omitted. Line "quiunt)" appears as printed in the scan as a fragment; the first line of the column is partly cut at the top. Some words in the lower lines are faint; "speetandam" and "Quáta 'verò" read with doubt.
